amelia: pushed a minimal Next + LangChain sample to github.com/redwood/sample-next-lite — goal is a tiny eval boot sample for onboarding. CI e2e is failing with auth/retry errors on edge runtime, anyone seen this?

 sam: can you paste the failing log?

 amelia: ```
 Error: 401 Unauthorized - missing api key
  at fetch (/workspace/node_modules/redwood-sdk/dist/index.js:45:12)
 Retry attempts exhausted
 ```

 ashwin: classic — sounds like the sample is referencing a public env var. Are you accidentally using NEXT_PUBLIC_REDWOOD_API_KEY in the API route? Edge and SSR env handling differ.

 amelia: hmm yeah the api route currently does: `new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_REDWOOD_API_KEY })` — I did that to make local dev easier.

 maria: that's the bug. NEXT_PUBLIC_* vars are shipped to the client. For server-only calls on Next you must use REDWOOD_API_KEY (no NEXT_PUBLIC). For Vercel edge runtime, also remember only certain envs are available; prefer `fetch` with explicit Authorization header in server code: `headers: { 'authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}` }`.

 sam: small parity note: JS SDK will auto-retry idempotent endpoints by default, but our Python SDK doesn't. We should call this out in the sample README so folks know to add retries in cross-lang examples. Filed a doc issue.

 devex-bot: suggestion: add retry wrapper snippet to sample: ```js
 // example retry wrapper
 const client = new RedwoodClient({ retry: { retries: 3, backoff: 200 } })
 ```

 amelia: another symptom: the eval harness sometimes hangs on streaming responses — e2e times out after 30s with `Connection closed by peer` after ~29s. Logs show stream closed without final event.

 ashwin: for streaming you need to wire the streaming handler into the Next edge/SSR runtime correctly. In the sample replace the naive `await client.generate()` with streaming handler: `for await (const chunk of client.streamGenerate(...)) { /* forward */ }` and set a stream timeout config in the runtime. Also verify the model variant supports streaming.

 maria: proposed actions: 1) fix env var usage in sample (use REDWOOD_API_KEY in server code), 2) add README section: server vs client keys + edge runtime caveats, 3) include retry wrapper example and short note on SDK parity (JS vs Python), 4) add minimal telemetry hook to the sample so first-run failures are visible to devex.

 sam: I'll take README + retry wrapper and the SDK parity blurb. Assigning to @sam :+1:.

 amelia: I'll push the hotfix to api route and add a failing test that reproduces the missing-key error. Will also try the streaming handler patch.

 ci-bot: Build triggered for branch `fix/sample-env-2746120000` — tests queued.

 devex-bot: added checklist item to onboarding: "verify sample runs in both node and edge runtimes" :memo: 

 maria: thanks — once PRs land, can we add a one-liner in the console quickstart to mention which sample to pick (lite vs full) depending on whether you need streaming/eval? Saves confusion.

 amelia: good call. I'll add that to the PR description. Thanks all! :rocket:
